meta.system: Tenebra (default) with Aetherial Mercury as alternate pack
meta.source: crates/ferrite-shell/src/theme.rs (constants + PaletteTokens) and crates/ferrite-chrome/src/tokens.rs (pack CSS). Values here must match those files; theme.rs unit tests pin every hex.
meta.fonts: Geist Pixel Square and JetBrains Mono are bundled (crates/ferrite-shell/assets/fonts/, served via ferrite://assets, @font-face in theme_css). General UI text is system-ui stack - Inter is NOT bundled and only renders if installed locally (some chrome packs list it first).
meta.font_surfaces: pixel: keyboard-hint badges + short technical labels via --f-font-pixel. mono: omnibox, sync code box, telemetry/console output via --f-font-mono. If you never use hints, the pixel face is nearly invisible - that is expected.

usage.accentArchive: Contextual only when the archive view is active. Must never appear during live browsing.

kit.icon: Phosphor Icons (MIT, phosphoricons.com), inlined as SVG paths (no font, no fetch), 256 grid, currentColor tint. Regular = default/off, Bold = lit, Fill = toggled-on. Unknown weights fall back to Regular. tabular-nums for JetBrains Mono readouts
kit.bordersOverShadows: 1px solid borderSubtle paired with bg contrast, not drop shadows
kit.buttons: rounded-sm 2px or rounded-none 0px, never rounded-full pill clash with pixel, px-3 py-1.5 small, px-4 py-2 primary, 8px increments
kit.tables: tabular-nums on all numerical cells, hover transition-colors duration-100 ease-out

typography.geistPixelUsage: Short, fixed-width technical labels only (link hints a/s/d/f, Waterfall status codes, Shield counters) - not body or omnibox
typography.jetBrainsUsage: Omnibox and all telemetry/data-dense output (Waterfall, Console)
typography.interUsage: Page titles and general UI chrome text
